about_the_game:
Slightly based on a true story, where someone goes through depression and a hard time. On the verge of suicide. 

It is a 2d puzzle platformer with some psychological horror elements. You will be controlling a whisp, we did this to leaving the interpretation of the Character to the players.

You will go through a set of levels, which is a platformer and a puzzle game.

content_descriptors.notes: The game talks about suicide, and has some implied suicidal scenes
